concerns.text: The plan’s task ordering (step 6) calls for ‘partial correlation / multivariate analysis’ to address chemical coupling of Pb/I/MA, but no task in tasks.md implements this analysis or produces the required output fields.

Task T101 (Data Ingestion) does not specify generation of provenance metadata linking aligned/processed maps to their raw sources and preprocessing script version, violating Constitution Principle VI (Spatial Characterization Consistency).

Task T104 (Full statistical modeling) produces analysis_results.json without confidence‑interval fields, despite Constitution Principle VII requiring reporting of confidence intervals for Pearson r and p‑values.
